title: I4 POST /v1/decide request (also the item shape of I5 authorize_stateless, with record=false)

session.description: codec.session_key(ws, psid, kind, id); also the Dogwood launchpad.sessionId pin

workspace_id.description: Trusted caller workspace, independent of the engine set key in ws. Omitted on legacy workspace-keyed calls.

expect.description: amendment 3: the set versions the caller's bundle holds; a mismatch with the engine's installed set => 409 set_mismatch (have = the engine's policy_set_version)

context.description: The WIRE context: input, agent_id, channel (+ expect). The Dogwood-side context that policies read (context.input, context.launchpad.{agent_id, channel, sessionId}, context.system.*) is built by the engine: launchpad.agent_id <- agent.agent_id, launchpad.channel <- context.channel, launchpad.sessionId <- the top-level `session` (codec.session_key, binding ws + psid + principal), system.* <- the engine clock. Never send a launchpad block, a psid or time.

tsv.description: amendment 2: the token's temporal-set version; older than the workspace's => 409 session_invalidated

session_started_at.description: amendment 2: the token's iat; older than the store epoch on a recorded call => 409 history_lost
